title: Center Transfer / Authority Migration
observed_structure: a stable composition establishes who or what owns the center
the center later becomes empty, occupied by another agent, or controlled by an object
the transfer changes action, access, or interpretation
cinematic_affordances: repeated axial framing with changed occupant
object or architecture inheriting visual authority
off-center actor forced to negotiate the central axis
cultural_scope: film-derived formal pattern; do not imitate specific Kubrick imagery
transferable_structure: center ownership is established, withdrawn, and reassigned to reveal a changed power relation
non_transferable_surface: specific corridors, costumes, carpets, monoliths, or production designs from Kubrick films
